vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: agenttimes
Version: 5.1.0

The skill provides a legitimate interface for a news intelligence API (agenttimes.live) using standard curl commands. It offers features such as semantic search, sentiment analysis, and webhook subscriptions without any evidence of data exfiltration, malicious execution, or prompt injection.

llm.summary: The skill is an instruction-only wrapper for a public news API (curl calls to https://agenttimes.live) and its requests and instructions are consistent with that purpose.

dimensions.detail: Name, description, and runtime instructions all describe using a public news API via curl; required binary (curl) is appropriate and no unrelated credentials or config paths are requested.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md only tells the agent to call public HTTP endpoints (/ask, /trending, /subscribe, /news) and to POST a webhook URL for subscriptions. It does not instruct reading local files or environment variables. Caution: subscribing requires providing a public webhook URL — exposing an agent-owned or internal URL could leak sensitive data if used as the webhook target.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec or third-party downloads — instruction-only skill (lowest install risk).
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: No environment variables, credentials, or config paths are requested; this is proportionate for a public, keyless API.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and agent invocation is user-invocable by default. The skill does not request persistent privileges or modification of other skills/config.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to be a simple instruction-only client for a public news API and is internally consistent. Before installing: (1) verify you trust the service at https://agenttimes.live and review its privacy/terms (it aggregates many feeds); (2) do not supply internal, localhost, or cloud-metadata endpoints as webhook URLs — only use a public HTTPS endpoint you control to avoid accidental data leakage; (3) avoid including secrets or credentials in subscription payloads or webhook URLs; (4) if you plan to process sensitive data returned by the API, verify retention, handling, and credibility claims with the vendor; and (5) test rate limits and pricing for endpoints that are billed. If you need more assurance, ask the maintainer for an author-signed service description or an API key/account flow documentation.
